about.title: About the Boundaries Crossed set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Boundaries Crossed is a Black & White expansion released on 7 November 2012. It has 153 cards: 149 in the main set and 4 secret rares. There are also 130 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 149 main set cards), the Master set (279 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 283 cards, adding the 4 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
